about.heading: Let's go beyond your limits together
about.p1: For years I've been discovering my own body's potential through calisthenics, and bringing that journey to hundreds of students. You don't need expensive equipment or a gym — just you, willpower and the right program.
about.p2: I build a custom program for every student based on their level, and track your progress step by step with technique videos and one-on-one feedback. The goal isn't just to get stronger; it's a more disciplined, more confident you.
